About Us

Greater Noida's Trusted Property Partner

Aadhar Properties has been a cornerstone of the Greater Noida and Yamuna Expressway real estate landscape for over 15 years. We understand the region — its sectors, its authorities, and its allotment processes — better than anyone else.

Whether you're a first-time buyer navigating GNIDA or YEIDA's allotment process or an investor looking for a residential or industrial plot, we offer honest guidance with zero pressure tactics. Our reputation is built entirely on repeat clients and word-of-mouth referrals.

We are conveniently located at Tradex Tower 2 in the Commercial Belt, Alpha 1st — one of Greater Noida's most accessible business addresses.
